entries.prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational.
Asset type: one rehabilitation exercise step photograph, portrait 4:5, single pose.
Create action 124 T-AXU-002 step s01, the neutral standing starting pose for gentle supported trunk extension. The three supplied reference images ONLY fix the same adult East Asian woman's face, age, natural skin tone, black ponytail, white plain short sleeve T-shirt, charcoal dark grey long trousers, photoreal studio style, soft lighting, grey-blue seamless background. Do not copy their arm gestures.
True SIDE VIEW showing complete head, hands, hips, knees and both whole feet with generous floor margin, woman faces RIGHT. Camera at mid torso height, neutral lens perspective, full body centered. She stands comfortably with feet about hip width, BOTH entire soles and heels of simple white athletic shoes fully flat on floor. Knees softly unlocked, pelvis neutral, torso naturally upright without exaggerated chest lifting or back arch. BOTH hands lightly rest on the lateral pelvis at the iliac crests, elbows relaxed, fingers anatomically natural, no force pushing the lower back. The near hand clearly touches the near pelvic side; farther hand may be partly occluded in true profile. Head and neck in comfortable neutral alignment, calm expression looking forward. Plain grey-blue studio floor, realistic soft contact shadows.
Constraints: same reference identity, natural human limb lengths and joint connections, no chair or wall or other props; single frame only, no text, no labels, no arrows, no symbols, no watermark. Neutral starting pose must not lean backward yet. Output should be a clean anatomical teaching photo.

inspection.method: 最终保存路径逐张view_image视觉审查；123及124另经独立代理核对
inspection.posture: 侧面自然直立，双膝自然微松，近侧手轻扶骨盆上缘侧前方，头颈舒适。
inspection.support_and_contacts: 双脚原位全掌着地；近侧手骨盆接触可见，远侧手被躯干遮挡。
inspection.anatomy: 肢段比例与关节连续，未见明显多肢或断裂；手指遮挡处不能从单帧核实。
inspection.appearance: 人物脸部、黑马尾、白短袖、深灰长裤、灰蓝背景及柔和棚拍与参考保持视觉一致。
inspection.text_check: 原始照片无文字、编号及箭头。
inspection.limits: 远侧手在侧视下被遮挡，轻扶力度及精确后伸角度不能由照片验证。

entries.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve.
Asset type: rehabilitation action 124 T-AXU-002 step s02, one portrait photograph.
Edit the supplied neutral standing image into the GENTLE SMALL-RANGE TRUNK EXTENSION endpoint. Keep EXACTLY the same woman identity, ponytail, white T-shirt, charcoal trousers, white athletic shoes, true side-view camera, subject scale, framing, grey-blue studio floor and background, lighting and foot locations. Woman continues facing RIGHT.
Change only her torso and head as needed for a small comfortable backward movement: pelvis stays in place, both hands keep their light contact on lateral pelvic crests, knees remain softly unlocked, both shoe soles and heels stay entirely planted at exactly the original positions. Above the pelvis her upper trunk gently extends backward (toward image LEFT), shoulders and upper chest shift slightly left from the upright reference, about one third of a head-width. Her trunk inclines only roughly 10–15 degrees backward, not a deep backbend. Head and neck follow the small trunk movement with chin relaxed and eyes roughly forward, no dramatic head tipping or neck hyperextension. Natural modest lumbar extension; no knee lock, no pelvis thrust forward, no foot movement, no lifted toes/heels.
Full body visible from head to both complete shoes, anatomy realistic. One clear pose only. No text, arrows, overlays, measurements, labels, watermark or collage. The distinction from s01 should be visible through the upper trunk gently moving backward while pelvis and support remain stable.

inspection.support_and_contacts: 双脚鞋底保持地面接触，无抬脚或迈步；近侧手接触骨盆，远侧手被躯干遮挡。

entries.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve.
Asset type: one rehabilitation action 127 T-AXU-005 step s01 photograph, portrait 4:5.
Edit the supplied seated woman photo to show the NATURAL RELAXED NEUTRAL SITTING START POSITION before gently rounding the upper back. Keep this exact woman's face, black ponytail, age, skin, plain white short sleeve shirt, charcoal grey long trousers, white athletic shoes, stable grey four-legged chair, grey-blue background, soft lighting, same side-view camera and subject scale.
Change her upper body from forward leaning to natural relaxed sitting: pelvis stays on the front/middle of the chair seat, both feet stay fully flat in their original positions, knees comfortably bent, torso upright with a natural soft spinal curve, shoulders down and relaxed, upper back neither exaggeratedly rounded nor forcefully straightened. Do not arch the lower back or push chest up. Head and neck comfortably over torso, eyes looking softly forward to RIGHT, no strong chin tuck or head drop. BOTH hands rest lightly palm-down on their corresponding thighs just above the knees, fingertips gently laid on thigh fabric, no crossed arms, elbows relaxed.
Retain visible chair-seat buttock support, shoulders hips and knees, and complete whole head, hands and shoes inside the frame. Anatomical limb proportions realistic. This is the preparation pose, not the rounded-back endpoint or a breathing diagram. No text, numbers, arrows, symbols, watermark, borders or collage.
